# Kenney Nature Kit

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit

The project includes a curated subset of the original Nature Kit 2.1 FBX
models: Altai-compatible pines, rocks, logs, stumps, bushes, grasses and
mushrooms. The full pack contains 330 assets; only the environmental families
used by TRip are vendored here.
